QuestInfo.name: New Alliance
QuestInfo.0: Listen to the council's decision from #p3000002#.
QuestInfo.1: #p3000002# says that the council has decided to join with the Maple World Alliance. Tell #p1101002# at\r\n#m130000000# about this.
QuestInfo.2: A new alliance has been formed! Nova and Maple World are now allies.

0.0: Kaiser. The Council has reached a decision.

yes.0: We have agreed to ally with the Cygnus Knights, despite the dangers of going to war with two Transcendents. Please inform the Cygnus Knights of our decision.

no.0: Wait, don't you want to hear the decision?

1.0: Welcome. I trust you have brought good news?

yes.0: Excellent. This is a golden opportunity for both of our worlds. I will inform the Alliance and begin formalizing the arrangement. Thank you for your part in this, Kaiser.

npc.0: Didn't you need to talk to #m130000000#? Oh, was it #p1101002#? Well, let them know what we've decided.
